capabilities: Convert Markdown notes into WeChat-compatible HTML
Preview articles in mobile and desktop layouts
Apply article layouts and color themes
Create WeChat drafts and image cards through the official API
disambiguation: Not a general Markdown-to-HTML converter; it targets WeChat Official Account drafts and image cards.
extras: Desktop-only; installed manually from GitHub release files (main.js, manifest.json, styles.css). Configuration and usage details are in separate Chinese documentation not included in the README.
problem: Notes written in Obsidian cannot be sent to a WeChat Official Account directly, because WeChat needs its own HTML markup and image handling.

relations.evidence: creates drafts through the official WeChat API

summary: Formats Markdown notes into WeChat-compatible HTML and submits them as WeChat Official Account drafts, with image cards and long-image export.
